payload.summary: Refined the plan-roadmap scaffold for ri-02, grounded against the real typesafe-sdk package (installed from PyPI v0.7.0 and introspected directly) rather than the assessment doc's paraphrase. Found and corrected two wrong targets (architecture.config.yaml for thresholds, 'the existing Langfuse hook' for telemetry) and named a fourth decide() failure branch the scaffold missed.

decisions.title: Threshold config: package-owned JSON, not architecture.config.yaml
decisions.rationale: architecture.config.yaml is scoped to the architecture-report generator with no threshold concept; YAML parsing would need pyyaml, violating ri-01's still-active no-required-dependencies requirement.

decisions.title: decide() gains the same optional event_sink decide_intent() already has
decisions.rationale: 'the existing Langfuse hook' is a session-transcript hook unrelated to decide() call sites; mirroring decide_intent()'s D2 keeps the package free of a langfuse dependency.

next_steps: Implement Phases 1-3 per the refined tasks.md

relevant_files.description: D1-D5, grounded in the real SDK API surface
